# Adversarial MNIST: a 3 classified as 7

- Source: Battista Biggio, Igino Corona, Davide Maiorca, Blaine Nelson,
  Nedim Srndic, Pavel Laskov, Giorgio Giacinto, and Fabio Roli,
  *Evasion Attacks against Machine Learning at Test Time* (2013).
- PDF: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1708.06131 (the later arXiv copy of the cited paper).
- Figure 3, page 10: the first two panels of the top row, without mimicry.
  The left image is the original; the right is the first attack image
  misclassified as 7 by the linear SVM.
- Downloaded and extracted 2026-10-19. Crop in PDF points, measured from the
  upper-left corner of the 612-by-792-point source page: (172, 117, 304, 191).
- The PDF crop retains the original image and labels without retouching.
  Remaining panels, convergence plots, and original caption are omitted.
- Existing bibliography key: `biggio-13`.
- Attribution identifies the source; it does not establish reuse permission.
